China's control of precious metals and Oil.

China holds serious power when it comes to the flow of precoius metals as they are huge producers. They are also "secretly" stockpiling gold alongside other BRICS nations (related to the gold backed BRICS currency) to lower the dependency on the dollar. This is also related to oil, and this is where it gets interesting. China was relying on its oil stockpile (biggest in the world by a large margin) since june, and this is essentially what saved the supply shock in may/april when they announced it. China could have rebought the oil they chose not to in June at a lower price in july but didn't indicating that the reason for relying on stockpiles wasn't necessarily financial and potentially related to the power battle between the US and China. Recently China started buyng again and I believe this is the reason we saw oil prices rebound on the 10th of november.
